Fast forward to today, together with our team of 50 super-talented designers, engineers, marketing, and operations experts, we’ve become the fastest growing company to have ever existed in our industry. Our vision forward is to deepen our existing reach, and to expand into new product categories, turning our wild crazy dreams into reality. That’s more or less it. But if you’re still curious, keep scrolling. Our growing team Ofek Software Engineer Michael Head of Engineering Tal Team Lead Adiel Head of Engineering Ori Head of Ops (Around) Dori Software Engineer Dror Software Engineer Ido Head of Engineering Adam Head of Design Yuval Product Manager Nimrod iOS Engineer Din QA Engineer Evyatar Product Designer Inbal Head of Design Jonathan Software Engineer Avishai Software Engineer Chen Software Engineer Our stack Express JS React Node JS Redis Cloudinary Sentry AWS Mongo Heroku Loggly Amplitude BigQuery Looker Optimizely Buddybuild Github Swift Fivetran Stitch Data CircleCI Cloudflare Figma Why we need tech? Mixtiles needs tech for the same reason Amazon needs tech. To continue scaling our products and creating more beautiful homes at a super-fast pace, we use the software in every part of our business to continually optimize it - digital product, manufacturing, marketing, and customer service. This has been the key to our success ever since the company's founding. Scale Mixtiles is growing at a fast pace, and just keeping everything operational is a challenge 3B+ Events Per Year Processing 81.3M photos per year 30 Millions square meters covered with tiles Over 3M happy customers 300 Millions people see us on Facebook each month Manufacturing & Shipping Automation Our software controls manufacturing and shipping in all our factories, for exceptional cost efficiency and reliable fulfillment of our customer's orders 7 Factories on 3 continents, delivering to tens of thousands of customers per month Big Data & Machine learning At every moment, millions of events are collected At every moment we have a few tens of A/B test running We are leveraging more than 1B yearly events, and make more than 100K yearly queries to learn about our users and drive growth Augmented Reality We think the future of home design is Augmented Reality, we're developing cutting edge technology for designing homes in a magical way. Mixtiles Photos from your phone to your wall Mixtiles Art The best art marketplace in the world easyplant Smart plants that live forever Working at Mixtiles We’re looking for talented people, who share our passion for building great products that millions of people bring inside their homes. Join The Team

Mixtiles R&D teams are running as separate squads, each executing on their own goals and focusing on their products. We do sprints, working to create a fast impact. Our squads are small (3-5 people) and work closely with product managers and designers to bring changes to life. We care deeply about each other and what we do. We make data-based decisions on how our culture should look, gathering as much feedback as possible from employees and striving to build the best experience for all. We ensure whoever joins us shares our vision and our way of operating. Who are you?
